title: Mom & Grandma
description: Two women sit close together by a window, one resting an arm around the other. Watercolor over pencil and fine liner, with a Swedish caption naming them Mom and Grandma.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: My Son
description: A watercolor portrait of my son in a blue sweater, chewing on a blade of grass, set in an oval with a green countryside behind him.

title: Old Lady
description: A pencil portrait of an elderly woman with deeply lined features and wispy hair, in a V-neck sweater against a cross-hatched background.

title: Portrait of a Girl with Deer Eyes
description: A pencil portrait of a young woman with long bangs, wide dark-rimmed eyes, and a slight smirk. Signed and dated 2010.

title: Yggdrasil
description: The Norse world tree drawn as a gnarled, serpent-entwined giant in a forest clearing, with a volcano in the background and a tiny warrior looking on from the right.

title: Air — School Project
description: A figure in a white fluffy costume and doll-like mask lies back on pale fabric, as if floating. A costume photo for the element of air in a school project.

title: Fire — School Project
description: A figure covered in glowing red and orange body paint holds small flames in outstretched hands against a black background. A body paint photo for the element of fire in a school project.

title: Water — School Project
description: A figure in blue body paint and long blue hair climbs out of an indoor swimming pool in a dark hall. A body paint photo for the element of water in a school project.

title: Insect Demon
description: A blue-skinned creature with large insect eyes and a mouthful of sharp teeth, wrapped in a golden scarf against a purple wash. Pencil, fine liner, and watercolor.

title: Tentacle Nightmare
description: A mass of writhing tentacles surrounds a central mass of teeth and eyes, drawn in dense pencil hatching.

title: Ant Cup
description: An ant whose body is a coffee cup, with coffee beans spilling around its feet.

title: Eyes and Nose
description: A close-up of a wide-eyed face with a furrowed brow, framed by a rectangular border.

title: Seglora Church
description: A quick pencil sketch of Seglora Church on a small hill, with the name written on its base.

title: The Sacrifice
description: A figure with outstretched arms and legs is pinned to a large wheel inside a frame with rings at its corners.

title: Demon Beast
description: A beast lunges toward the viewer with an open, toothy mouth, a jagged mane, and clawed hands, drawn in fast, slashing strokes.

title: Reading by the Light
description: Tall stacks of books tower around a tiny figure reading in the dim light of a lamp.

title: Mug Shot
description: Three mug characters stand against a barred wall in a police lineup, each holding a placard.

title: Pencil Mantis
description: A mix between a praying mantis and a pencil: the pencil forms its long body, with the mantis head and folded arms at the top.

title: Boy with Cap
description: A smiling boy in an LA baseball cap, drawn in loose pencil lines.

title: Boy with Closed Eyes
description: A boy with closed eyes and tousled hair, with a bowl and a grid of lines behind him.

title: Me and My Better Half I
description: A close double portrait of me and my better half, both in glasses, with our heads leaning together.

title: Me and My Better Half II
description: A second portrait of me and my better half, this time with one head resting on the other's shoulder.

title: Parrot and Woman
description: A woman in glasses and a headband with a parrot perched on her shoulder.

title: Tree by the Fence
description: A pencil sketch of a tree standing beside a fence, with a field and hills behind it.

title: Elephant Man (v1)
description: A surreal portrait of an older man with swept-back white hair, an elephant's trunk, and tusks, in a brown shirt against a cloudy green and yellow background.

title: Atelje Kopiko Logo
description: Around 2012 I started an illustration and set design company with a friend. We called it Atelje Kopiko. This is the logo I made for it: pink lettering framed by ivy leaves and hop cones on a pale green background.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: A sketch of a remote-controlled cat
description: I really liked the idea of remote-controlled pets, and a cat seemed like the perfect candidate. In this first sketch, a cat with an antenna on its back stands on a platform while a hand holds the remote.

title: Elephant Man (V2)
description: The second iteration of the Elephant Man: a surreal portrait with a more textured, bulbous head, a small trunk-like growth by the ear, and a blue collar against radiating green light.

title: Gabriel gräslök (1/2)
description: An art assignment where we were supposed to illustrate a short text. I chose the children's rhyme 'Gabriel gräslök'. This page has the opening verse, with a large initial letter growing from a flowerpot inside a border of vines.

title: Gabriel gräslök (2/2)
description: The second page of my 'Gabriel gräslök' assignment: chive-haired Gabriel types a letter, and in the panel below it gets torn up by someone in red platform shoes.

title: Tattoo design (original)
description: An illustration I made for a friend who asked me to create a tattoo design. He liked my 'Gabriel gräslök' illustration. A tree-like man sits on a green folding chair, with branches for hair.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Tattoo design sketch
description: The pencil sketch for the tattoo design: a tree-like man with branches for hair, sitting on a wooden chair.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Atelje Kopiko Website back button
description: The back button for the Atelje Kopiko website: a gray arrow making a U-turn, with rainbow-colored 3D letters spelling 'U-turn back' around it.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko blue flower
description: I created this for the Atelje Kopiko website, but I don't remember what for. A blue flower with long, tendril-like stamens on a green stem, against a yellow wash.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko home button
description: The home button for the Atelje Kopiko website: a red wooden cottage on a round patch of lawn.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko Ladybug (1/2)
description: The signature logo of Atelje Kopiko, a ladybug. My firstborn son used to call ladybugs 'Kopiko', which is where we got the name. Atelje Kopiko was a business I started around 2012 with a friend, doing illustration and set design for theater and film. This is a top view of the ladybug with its shell closed.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko Ladybug (2/2)
description: The same Atelje Kopiko ladybug with its wing cases open and its wings spread, ready to take off.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko Portfolio
description: The portfolio icon for the Atelje Kopiko website: a brown leather satchel with a buckle and a shoulder strap.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko Resume
description: The resume icon for the Atelje Kopiko website, representing both of our resumes: a scroll labeled 'Curriculum Vitae'.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko (Self portrait)
description: The self-portrait I had on the Atelje Kopiko website: a bearded man in a striped shirt in an ornate oval frame, with a halo and little devil horns.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Atelje Kopiko Tools of the trade
description: The tools-of-the-trade illustration for the Atelje Kopiko website: pens, pencils, and brushes fanned out across the page, showing the tools we used to create our work.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Self portrait orange 1/2
description: A self-portrait from around the time I did the illustrations for the Atelje Kopiko website. It never made it to the website, but I liked it and kept it. Here I'm wrapped in a hooded orange cloth.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Self portrait red 2/2
description: The second self-portrait from the same period, never used on the Atelje Kopiko website. Here I'm pulling a pink-red cloth over my head, against blue panels.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Study of an Octopus
description: For a time I got really into drawing water creatures, octopuses in particular. A pencil study of an octopus with curling tentacles, its eye and funnel in focus.

title: Guardian of the holy grail
description: I made this drawing while I was into robots and two-legged machines. A ballpoint pen robot with weapon arms, labeled 'Guardian of the Holy Grail'. The name is a story I made up while visualizing the drawing.

title: Walking bot (Exploration edition)
description: I made this drawing while I was into robots and two-legged machines. A boxy walking robot with an antenna and a grabber arm, supposed to explore unknown planets and terrain.

title: Walking Cabriolet 1/2
description: I made this drawing while watching a series called 'Eureka'. The intro had a hovering car, which somehow made me think of a walking car. Here a convertible walks on mechanical legs along a cobblestone street.

title: Walking Cabriolet 2/2
description: A red pen version of the walking cabriolet, with the car on spidery legs next to a smaller boxy walker. Inspired by the hovering car in the intro of 'Eureka'.

title: Walking bot (Home edition)
description: I made this drawing while I was into robots and two-legged machines. I imagined this robot as built in 1932 and steam powered, with the moving parts visible on the outside of its shell. Labeled 'Walk bot, Model 1.5, Year 1932'.

title: Walking hunter craft
description: I made this drawing while I was into robots and two-legged machines. I was heavily inspired by the game Dishonored and its stilt-walkers (the Tall Boys). A long-legged machine hangs from a thin line that ends in a small spiked wheel.

title: Walking Mech
description: I made this drawing while I was into robots and two-legged machines. My attempt at creating a mech: a gray, marker-colored machine with a boxy cockpit, a cannon, and bent legs.

title: Video of how I created the Elephant Man (V1)
description: A video of how I created the first version of the Elephant Man, from start to finish.

title: Video of how I created the Elephant Man (V2)
description: A time-lapse video of how I created the second version of the Elephant Man, from start to finish.

title: Sketch of flying organic spaceship
description: A digital sketch of organic spaceships: two green, curved ships with glass bubbles at the front and orange thrust trails, next to a rough pencil study.

title: Video of how I created the flying organic spaceship sketch
description: A video of how I created the flying organic spaceship sketch.

title: Cargo ship sketch
description: A doodle I made while waiting for somebody: a long cargo ship with boxy modules and hanging cylindrical tanks, drawn in ballpoint pen.

title: Center rotor driven hover craft
description: I was inspired by the movie The Incredibles. A ballpoint pen sketch of a disc-shaped hover craft with a ring of rotor blades around a bubble cockpit.

title: Character iterations (Kay & Oya)
description: I made some character variations with my mother of aliens and whimsical characters. A page of small framed watercolor portraits, labeled as a ship pilot, a general, and a Starfleet pilot, among others.

title: Crab sketch
description: A pencil study of what a crab looks like, seen from the front with its eyes raised on stalks and a shadow beneath it.

title: Feast of the ants
description: A sketch I made inspired by what creatures look like when they are eaten or decayed. Ants with oversized heads swarm over the ribcage of a decaying animal beneath the trees.

title: Lunar droid
description: One of many drawings about robots, droids, and space. A small wheeled rover droid with a periscope-eye arm and an antenna, speeding along.

title: Old tree
description: I was inspired by the ents in Lord of the Rings. A tall tree creature with scaly green bark, long arms with many fingers, and root feet, standing in a bare winter forest.

title: Walking vehicle (1800s)
description: I like the idea of walking vehicles, retro or futuristic. A goggled pilot sits on a steampunk hover vehicle that walks on two jointed legs.

title: Study of old phones
description: I think the phones we used to have at home look interesting and are fun to draw. Three old telephones: a black rotary phone, a cradle phone with its receiver off the hook, and an older wooden-box model.

title: Six legged war walker
description: I always think it's fun to create drawings at a fantastical scale. A giant walker with a saucer-shaped body and long jointed legs towers over a small house, a fence, and a row of pine trees.

title: WormSnake
description: A creature that is similar to a snake and a worm at the same time, but unique in its own way. Two of them, with ring-shaped mouths and their tongues out.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Birdie (Take Off)
description: Part of a series of drawings of Birdie, a character I created while I was in art school. Here Birdie takes off, wings spread and feathers drifting away.

title: Birdie (Neutral and looking pose)
description: Part of a series of drawings of Birdie, a character I created while I was in art school. Here Birdie stands in a neutral pose, with two marker studies of its head and beak.

title: Birdie (Pooping)
description: Part of a series of drawings of Birdie, a character I created while I was in art school. Here Birdie bends forward with its head down, droppings arcing to the ground behind it.

title: Birdie (Nesting)
description: Part of a series of drawings of Birdie, a character I created while I was in art school. Here Birdie sits on a nest on a tree branch.

title: Flat Crab
description: An iteration from when I tried to create a crab character: a flat, spiked crab with its eyes on stalks, drawn in pencil.

title: Crab Characters
description: An iteration from when I tried to create a crab character. A page of crab ideas: a pencil crab with big claws, a yellow-spotted spidery one, and a blue one with a spiky snail-like shell.

title: The General
description: This drawing came out of one of my late-night drawing sessions. A three-eyed alien officer with a bumpy, egg-shaped head and a blue uniform with green epaulettes, arms crossed.

title: Heavy-duty walker
description: For a while, I was really into bipedal and quadrupedal walking machines. A bulky, riveted bipedal walker with an antenna, an exhaust stack, and a cockpit in its boxy body.

title: Quadruped robot (Home Basic Edition)
description: A page of boxy home robots on long legs, with the quadruped version labeled 'Home Basic Robot, Lite Edition, 1937'.

title: Sketches of legged walkers
description: For a while, I was really into bipedal and quadrupedal walking machines. A page of ideas, from an armed bipedal mech with twin cannons to smaller leg and joint studies.

title: Sketches of portfolio icons (Atelje Kopiko)
description: Some of the iterations for the portfolio icon: pencil sketches of leather satchels, straps, and buckles, with 'Curriculum Vitae' written at the top.

title: Sketch for blue flower (Atelje Kopiko)
description: I made this sketch for the Atelje Kopiko website, but I don't remember what for. A lily-like flower with tendril stamens, with a small framed alternative version at the right.

title: Sketch of a Spaceship Bus
description: I have always liked drawing spaceships and sci-fi. A long, bus-like spaceship speeding forward, drawn in ballpoint pen.

title: Sketch of an Ore Transporter
description: I have always liked drawing spaceships and sci-fi. A long, boxy ore transporter with a robotic arm on top and labeled tanks hanging beneath it.

title: Guest book Closed (Atelje Kopiko)
description: A sketch for the guest book icon we intended to have on the website: a closed book with 'Guest Book' lettered on its cover and a metal clasp.

title: Guest book Open (Atelje Kopiko)
description: A sketch for the guest book icon we intended to have on the website: the book open, with ribbon bookmarks, a small key, and handwritten names on the page.

title: Self portrait with random sketches (Atelje Kopiko)
description: I made several iterations of my self-portrait and icons. This is one of them: a bearded man with tousled hair, next to lettering ideas for 'Contact' and 'Guest Book'.

title: Self portrait bust (Atelje Kopiko)
description: I made several iterations of my self-portrait. This is one of them: a grinning, bearded man shown as a bust on a pedestal.

title: Back button icon sketches (Atelje Kopiko)
description: One of several back button sketches: a U-turn arrow in perspective, with 'U-turn back' lettering curving around it.

title: Home button icon sketches (Atelje Kopiko)
description: One of several home button sketches: a small wooden cottage drawn from two sizes, with 'HOME' lettering and an arrow.

title: Portfolio button icon sketches (Atelje Kopiko)
description: One of several portfolio button sketches: a leather satchel from two angles, with 'Portfolio' lettering.

title: Guest book concept sketch (Atelje Kopiko)
description: An early, more fantastical idea for the guest book icon: dragons spring out of an open storybook, with a goblin and toadstools on the page.

title: Tools of the trade sketch (Atelje Kopiko)
description: Sketch studies of pencils and brushes for the Tools of the trade icon, fanned out in perspective with the construction lines still visible.

title: Study of ivy
description: A pencil study of an ivy leaf (murgröna).

title: Study of a hop flower
description: A pencil study of a hop cone (humleblomma), with a few leaf studies around it.

title: Study of an antique telephone
description: A detailed pencil study of an old crank telephone, with its coiled cord and receiver.

title: Cigar on ash tray
description: A cigar resting on a glass ashtray, its smoke curling up into a ghostly, skull-like face.

title: Fat happy cat sketch
description: A fat, striped cat lies on its back on a pillow, grinning with its paws in the air.

title: Living trees sketch
description: Two living trees in blue ballpoint pen: one strides along on human-like legs, while a stump creature with tendrils sits to the right.

title: Rat and random creature sketch
description: A page of animal sketches in ballpoint pen and marker: a sniffing rat, a long-nosed creature with orange fur, and a mechanical head.

title: Robot in different states (sneak and run mode)
description: A robot shown in two modes: crouched in sneak mode, and sprinting in run mode.

title: Scissor study
description: A pencil study of a pair of scissors.

title: Violin playing flower sketch
description: A flower with a smiling face playing the violin with its petals.

title: Graffiti 3D Shapes (Klara)
description: With this drawing I experimented with freer 3D shapes and volumes. Purple and teal letters twist through space, surrounded by floating black-and-white blocks linked by orange lines, with the name Klara in the corner.

title: Bush Man Tag (v1)
description: My graffiti tag used to be 'Bush Man'. This is one iteration of that tag: purple and red 3D letters on a teal splatter, with a spiky dark creature standing beside them.

title: Bush Man Tag (v2)
description: My graffiti tag used to be 'Bush Man'. This is one iteration of that tag: red and green letters on a purple background, next to a horned black beast and a banner reading 'The beast of darkness can never die'.

title: Bush Man Tag (v3)
description: My graffiti tag used to be 'Bush Man'. This is one iteration of that tag: black-outlined white letters, with a small growling creature on top, a spiked ball, and a blue spray can labeled 'Never ending can'.

title: Organically Grotesque CD Cover
description: This drawing was a pre-sketch for a CD cover that a friend of a friend asked me to make. Grotesque, fleshy figures and faces tangle with pink tendrils against a deep red background, with tiny figures curled up in bubbles.

title: Graffiti Sketch of the Name Lina
description: In this graffiti piece I experimented with 3D shapes and line work that were advanced for me at the time. Green and blue letters spell the name Lina over a purple cloud.

title: Graffiti Tattoo for Maria
description: A classmate asked me to design a tattoo for her, with her name written in my graffiti style. Black-outlined letters with deep shadows, and a note underneath dated April 2002.

title: Graffiti Marie
description: A graffiti piece based on the name of a girl I liked at the time, in lavender and blue letters with a black accent across a purple stripe.

title: Graffiti Two Flowers in Love
description: At the time, I was into a video game based on Alice in Wonderland, but with a dark twist. This drawing was inspired by that game. An Alice-like girl in a blue dress stands on a yellow path through a strange landscape of a walking TV, a crooked house, and a gnarled tree, with two flowers at her feet.

title: Graffiti Organic
description: The word 'Organic' in graffiti lettering. Here I was experimenting with a different graffiti style: sharp-edged black and white letters with striped 3D shading and a flower at the center.

title: Meat-Eating Flower Sketch
description: I was inspired by fantastical things in ordinary settings. A tall meat-eating flower rises from a pot in a kitchen, while a pointy-eared figure peeks out from behind the counter.

title: Study of Face Expressions
description: In these sketches, I was studying different extreme facial expressions, with a few heads peeking in from the edges of the page.

title: Study of Temples
description: A study of ancient temples (for an assessment): ink sketches of a stepped temple on a hill with a winding road, plus perspective studies of smaller buildings below.

title: Ancient Temple Wide View
description: A study of ancient temples from a wider angle (for an assessment): stepped pyramids on a walled terrace at the edge of a cliff.

title: Self-Portrait (v1)
description: A self-portrait of me, drawn digitally as a blue-skinned goblin with pointy ears, glasses, a green hat, and a flowery shirt against a yellow background.

title: Snazzy
description: I wanted to draw a human in a fun pose, and I found this man with a snazzy one. A man in a gray suit lowers his sunglasses with both hands, wide-eyed, against a red-striped background.

title: Sketches of Bugs
description: Insects and bugs have always interested me, both in how they look and how they work mechanically. On top of that, they look super cool and come in all shapes and sizes. Here a spider, a segmented grub, and a caterpillar.

title: Brain Optimization
description: I like drawing the human body opened up to reveal the machinery inside. A person looks down with the top of their skull lifted off, revealing a mechanical brain.

title: Reconnection with the Ancient Ones
description: I'm fascinated and inspired by H.R. Giger, and this image draws on his work. A mechanical figure sits in a tracked, throne-like machine, surrounded by cables, devices, and the outline of a skull.

title: Hand Study and Woman Getting Shot
description: In this drawing I captured what was in front of me, my own hand, alongside a cartoon character getting shot and how that might look.

title: Old Wise Turtle in Different Poses
description: A continuation of my experiments with the comic strip style, this time with a turtle character. Three armored turtles with long necks and spiked shells walk across a green meadow, the last one fast asleep.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Mountain God of Everest
description: Inspired by the artist Wayne Barlowe and his painting Type and Villar (1976): the gigantic walking mountain. A giant robed god sits on a throne in a stone hall, with a small statue labeled 'God of Everest' standing in an alcove beside it.

title: Assorted Sea Creatures
description: A study of various sea creatures: a large anglerfish, a seahorse, a small fish, and an anemone on a rock.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: The Mountain Philosopher
description: Inspired by the artist Wayne Barlowe and his painting Type and Villar (1976): the gigantic walking mountain. A cloaked giant with a mountain-shaped head stands beside a walled town, dated 30 March 2009.

title: Creatures Without a Dedicated Head
description: An experiment with beasts and monsters that have no head but a huge mouth full of razor-sharp teeth. A gray, robot-like one with a segmented tail sits beside rough pencil versions.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Various Sketches
description: Various sketches from the top of my head: a flying fish-like creature, a manta-like flyer, an ink-blot creature, and a girl sitting with a dog on a bench.

title: Birdie Comic Strip
description: Birdie is a character I drew in many phases. I liked the idea of a bird with human legs and feet. In this drawing I try out the style of a comic strip: Birdie stands on a dirt path through a wheat field, with a small panel of a farm and a tree above.

title: Birdie in Various Poses
description: More studies of Birdie, a character I developed in art school. Here I explore nesting, feeding, and take-off poses.

title: Cybernetic Processing (1/4)
description: A woman with an open skull on a processing platform, surrounded by machinery. Colored-pencil sketches of a futuristic capsule craft sit beside her.

title: Cybernetic Processing (2/4)
description: A portrait with the skull opened to reveal clockwork, next to sketches of brain-processing machines and robotic manipulators.

title: Cybernetic Processing (3/4)
description: An open machine "head" with mechanical insides, shown between sketches of books and a boy reading a bedtime story.

title: Cybernetic Processing (4/4)
description: A head fitted with emotion modules labeled Envy, Lust, and Humor, with dials to tune each one.

title: Fairy Tale Character Studies
description: A small creature hiding in a treasure chest, with a key lying beside it, above a pencil study of a giant lock mechanism.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Hover Craft Designs (1/2)
description: Concept sketches of hover vehicles in motion, with different cockpit and engine layouts.

title: Hover Craft Designs (2/2)
description: More hover craft ideas, ending in a steam-driven hover craft armed with a railgun.

title: Keys Studies
description: A page of studies of keys, locks, and key tags.

title: Mega Serpent Destroys Church
description: A giant armored serpent bursts through a church while a graveyard stirs below, drawn in isometric view.

title: Monster Studies (1/2)
description: Studies of a headless beast whose body is almost all mouth, with spiked skin and a long tail.

title: Monster Studies (2/2)
description: Anatomy studies of walking legs and arms, ranging from mechanical joints to muscle.

title: Radio Controlled Cat (1/4)
description: A remote-controlled cat, shown in action and charging from a wall outlet.

title: Radio Controlled Cat (2/4)
description: A tabby cat studied from life, above design sketches of the controller and its buttons.

title: Radio Controlled Cat (3/4)
description: A cat sleeping on its charging station, with a "Cat Charge" panel showing voltage and charge level.

title: Radio Controlled Cat (4/4)
description: Studies of hands operating the "Cat Control" remote.

title: Various Characters
description: Four alien and mutant character busts in ink and watercolor.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Custom Transformers Design
description: Two robot designs built from boxy frames, wheels, and pipes: a wheeled unit trailing smoke and a bird-headed walker with angular wings. "Roosterbot" is written at the top.

title: Bush Man Revived
description: A hunched, angry-eyed creature with a flat jagged top, long arms ending in hooks, and a belly covered in small holes, standing on a thorny hill. It is signed and captioned "Bush Man revived."

title: My Self Image of Old
description: A large toad holding a key, with a small treasure chest, a cassette player, an MP3 player with earbuds, headphones, and a pencil tin labeled "Pennor" laid out in front of it. The caption reads "Me and my stuff."

title: Oversized Trunk Rat
description: Studies of a creature with a long, ribbed trunk ending in a toothed mouth and a single watchful eye, shown in color and in pencil, with a close-up of the mouth and a page of clawed legs.
medium: Pencil, Water color pencils and Water color

title: Quick Kroki
description: A quick pencil sketch of a long-haired person sitting cross-legged and seen from behind, with one hand held out.

title: Study of Armor and Robes
description: Two standing character studies: a horned figure in loose robes holding a tall staff with a hanging charm, and a figure in bulky plated armor with spiked boots.

title: Study of Feet (1/2)
description: A pencil study of a pair of bare feet standing on a flat slab, seen from the front and slightly above.

title: Study of Feet (2/2)
description: A second foot study, with the feet shown at an angle and the toes pressed against the ground.

title: Study of an Old Lady in Robes (1/2)
description: A weathered older woman with loose hair, wrapped in a heavy shawl, looking straight out at the viewer in front of a stone wall. Tinted in blue and sepia.

title: Study of an Old Lady in Robes (2/2)
description: A shading study of a laughing older woman in a draped headscarf and a robe with a row of buttons, rendered in soft, detailed pencil.

title: Study of a USB Cable and Cup
description: Two still-life studies: a flower-patterned cup holding a safety pin and a crochet hook, and a USB extension cable with its male and female ends.

title: Various Sketches (Hands and Creatures)
description: A page of loose studies: hands, a pair of legs, a small man in a hat dangling from a thread, a screaming face with an eyeball on a stalk, and a few toothy creatures.

title: Walking Car
description: A green vintage car carried on long mechanical legs across a rocky desert, with a small figure leaning over the edge of the body.
medium: Pencil, Water color and Fine liner

title: Red Death's Mask
description: One of several drawings I made for my school application, meant to depict the Red Death from the plague story. Studies of a figure in a pale dress and glasses wearing a bright red mask, shown from several angles and holding a red-stained cloth, with handwritten notes marking the white dress and white socks.

title: Self-Portrait, Eyes Down
description: A pencil self-portrait with the head tilted down and eyes closed, with loose hatching in the hair, beard, and shoulder.

title: Me and Myself
description: A bold pencil self-portrait of the artist looking straight ahead while drawing, with a pencil in hand and the title handwritten beside it.
